# authwise_issuers (Data Source)

An OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect issuer: the login a set of clients shares, with its domain, token lifetimes and which realm or realms people sign in to (`config`). This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `issuers` (Attributes List) Every issuer under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--issuers))

<a id="nestedatt--issuers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `issuers`

Read-Only:

- `appearance_profile_id` (String)
- `config` (String)
- `domain_name` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
- `path` (String)
